# OpenZeppelin Contracts for Compact

> A library of Compact modules for secure smart contract development on Midnight, composed into
> consumer contracts and published on npm as `@openzeppelin/compact-contracts`.

These links describe the development branch (`main`). Releases are installed from npm, never
from `main`, so read the documentation of the version you installed: replace `main` in a URL
with its tag (`v<version>`). The audits index is the exception: always use the current one,
since each row names the commit and scope its report covers.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/README.md): overview, toolchain, installation and a usage example
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, design decisions and constraints
- [GUIDELINES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/GUIDELINES.md): coding conventions for contributors
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/AGENTS.md): where agents contributing to the repository start

## Module categories

One npm package, organized by category under `contracts/src/`. The
[contracts README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/contracts/README.md)
describes the layout of each module directory.

- [access](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/access): ownership and role-based access control, transparent and shielded
- [crypto](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/crypto): ElGamal and ECDH over Jubjub, secp256k1 ECDSA, EIP-712
- [multisig](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/multisig): signer registry, threshold approvals, proposals, treasuries, forwarders, presets
- [security](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/security): initialization, pausing, allowlists and blocklists
- [token](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/token): transparent, confidential and native shielded tokens, extensions, a preset
- [utils](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/utils): shared helpers and EVM ABI word encoding

## Examples and API reference

- [multisig examples](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/multisig/examples) and [token examples](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/src/token/examples): deployable contracts, one per preset
- [Integration tests](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/tree/main/contracts/test/integration): several modules composed into one contract
- [Documentation site](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts-compact): guides and the API reference for the modules it covers

## Audits and security

- [Audit index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/audits/README.md): each report with its release, commit, auditor and scope
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/compact-contracts/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
